conventions: IPA is converted from the chosen CMUdict ARPAbet.
AH0 → ə, ER0 → ɚ, ER1 → ɝ.

items.example: I read the news every day.

miniDialogue.en: The seat cushion is red.
I found the red one. It is a colour, not led.
miniDialogue.yue: 我搵到紅色嗰張。呢個係顏色，唔係 led。

items.example: She led the way.
items.say: She led the way.

miniDialogue.en: She led the guests past the piano.
miniDialogue.yue: 佢帶啲客人行過架鋼琴。

miniDialogue.en: Yes. Ana led them, and led is not red.
miniDialogue.yue: 係。Ana 帶佢哋，而且 led 唔係 red。

items.example: A table by the window.
items.say: A table by the window.

miniDialogue.en: Can we go by taxi?
Yes. By taxi is fastest.

items.example: Please come back.
items.say: Please come back.

miniDialogue.en: Will the manager come back after lunch?
miniDialogue.yue: 經理食完午餐返唔返嚟？

miniDialogue.en: She returns once the supplier meeting ends.

items.example: I'll take this one.
items.say: I'll take this one.

miniDialogue.en: Should I take a number?
Yes. Take one from the machine.

items.example: We can seat you now.
items.say: We can seat you now.
items.note: 同 seat 名詞同音。

miniDialogue.en: Can you seat the four of us together?
miniDialogue.yue: 可唔可以安排我哋四個人坐埋一齊？

miniDialogue.en: Yes. We can seat you beside the garden.
miniDialogue.yue: 得。我哋可以安排你哋坐喺花園旁邊。

items.example: The first sound is soft.
items.say: The first sound is [[sˈɑft]].
items.note: CMU 主條 /sɑft/，另收 /sɔft/。卡片跟主條。

miniDialogue.en: The first sound is soft, almost nothing.
miniDialogue.yue: 第一個音好輕，幾乎冇聲。

miniDialogue.en: I'll keep the sound soft, like the start of about.
miniDialogue.yue: 我會將個音讀輕，好似 about 開頭咁。

items.example: I'll go with you.
items.say: I'll go with you.
items.note: CMU 主條同 Wiktionary 都係 /wɪð/。/wɪθ/ 係真實但較少嘅尾音變體。J1 會特別練 /wɪθ/，並且標明係變體。

miniDialogue.en: Can I pay with cash?
Yes. With cash at till three.

items.example: I'll be right with you.
items.say: I'll be right [[wˈɪθ]] you.
items.note: 呢張卡只練清音變體，唔係唯一標準音。主卡係 with-prep /wɪð/。

miniDialogue.en: Can I pay with cash?
Yes. Pay with notes if you can.

items.example: The boat sank.
items.say: The boat sank.
items.note: 對比組。唔好用嚟代替 thank。

miniDialogue.en: The toy boat sank when the wave hit it.
miniDialogue.yue: 個浪打過嚟，玩具船就沉咗。

miniDialogue.en: Pull it out and tip the water away.

items.example: The water tank is full.
items.say: The water tank is full.

miniDialogue.en: The water tank on the roof is full.
After the check, close the tank lid tightly.
miniDialogue.yue: 檢查完之後，閂實個水箱蓋。
miniDialogue.say: After the check, [[klˈoʊz]] the tank lid tightly.

items.example: I think so.
items.say: I think so.

miniDialogue.en: Do you think this fits?
I think it fits well.

items.example: The sink is full.
items.say: The sink is full.

miniDialogue.en: The sink is full of breakfast cups.
miniDialogue.yue: 洗碗盆堆滿早餐用嘅杯。

miniDialogue.en: I'll clear the sink before we open.
miniDialogue.yue: 開門之前我會清個洗碗盆。

items.example: A table for three.
items.say: A table for three.
items.note: 係 /θ/，唔係 /f/。

miniDialogue.en: We have three questions about the lease.
miniDialogue.yue: 關於租約我哋有三個問題。

miniDialogue.en: Ask them all before you pay the deposit.

items.example: A tree by the door.
items.say: A tree by the door.

miniDialogue.en: There is a tree by the door, not three.
One trunk only, so the tree is not three.
miniDialogue.yue: 得一條樹幹，所以棵樹唔係 three。

items.example: A sheet of paper.
items.say: A sheet of paper.

miniDialogue.en: Can I take a sheet of paper?
Yes. This sheet is blank on both sides.

items.example: Don't cheat.
items.say: Don't cheat.
items.note: 對比組：/tʃ/ 對 /ʃ/。

miniDialogue.en: Did anyone cheat on the quiz?
No. Nobody cheated.

items.example: I need a new shoe.
items.say: I need a new shoe.

miniDialogue.en: I need a new shoe for my left foot.
Try this shoe. The front is wide.

items.example: Chew slowly.
items.say: Chew slowly.

miniDialogue.en: Should I chew this slowly?
Yes. Chew before you swallow.

items.example: Let me know if you need anything.
items.say: Let me know if you need anything.

miniDialogue.en: Can you help me with this bag?
miniDialogue.yue: 可唔可以幫我拎呢個袋？

miniDialogue.en: Sure. Pass it to me.

items.example: Please go to the gate.
items.say: Please go to the gate.

miniDialogue.en: Which way do I go?
Go straight, then left.

items.example: Window or aisle?
items.say: Window or aisle?

miniDialogue.en: Tea or coffee?
Tea, please.

items.example: The aisle seat is free.
items.say: The aisle seat is free.
items.note: 呢度係座位仲有，唔係免費。

miniDialogue.en: The aisle seat is free on this flight.
Lovely. Free means the seat is open, and the fare still applies.
miniDialogue.yue: 好。Free 係個位仲空，機票錢照收。

items.example: Put the liquids in the tray.
items.say: Put the liquids in the tray.
items.note: 安檢用嘅膠盤，唔係垃圾桶。

miniDialogue.en: Empty your pockets into the grey tray.
miniDialogue.yue: 請將袋入面嘅嘢放入灰盤。

miniDialogue.en: My coins and keys are already inside.
miniDialogue.yue: 硬幣同鎖匙已經放咗入去。

items.arpabet: L IH1 K W IH0 D
items.example: Put the liquids in the tray.
items.say: Put the [[lˈɪkwɪdz]] in the tray.
items.note: CMU 有 /ˈlɪk.wɪd/ 同 /ˈlɪk.wəd/。卡片教 /ɪ/ 嗰條。錄音跟卡片。

miniDialogue.en: Please put the liquids in the tray.
miniDialogue.yue: 唔該將啲液體放落個盤。

miniDialogue.en: Done. All the liquids are under the limit.

items.arpabet: L AE1 P T AA2 P
items.example: Here is my laptop.
items.say: Here is my [[lˈæpˌtɑp]].
items.note: 兩個音節。重音喺 lap，top 有次重音。

miniDialogue.en: My laptop is already out of the sleeve.
miniDialogue.yue: 我部手提電腦已經由電腦套拎咗出嚟。

miniDialogue.en: Thanks. Keep the laptop out until the scan.
miniDialogue.yue: 多謝。掃描完之前唔好收好部手提電腦。

items.example: Please take off your belt.
items.say: Please take off your belt.
items.note: 有 /l/。同 left 一樣，元音係 /ɛ/。

miniDialogue.en: This leather belt is too stiff for me.
miniDialogue.yue: 呢條皮帶對我嚟講太硬。

miniDialogue.en: The softer brown one may feel better.
miniDialogue.yue: 軟身啡色嗰條可能舒服啲。

items.example: Go straight ahead.
items.say: Go straight ahead.
items.note: 元音係 /eɪ/。唔好讀成 street 嘅 /i/。

miniDialogue.en: Should I go straight at the sign?
miniDialogue.yue: 去到個指示牌我係咪直行？

miniDialogue.en: Go straight. Straight rhymes with eight, not street.
miniDialogue.yue: 直行。Straight 同 eight 押韻（/eɪ/），唔似 street。

items.example: The gate is straight ahead.
items.say: The gate is straight ahead.
items.note: 兩個音節。第一個音好輕 /ə/，重音喺 head。

miniDialogue.en: Keep going ahead until you see the red gate.
I think I can see the roof from here.
miniDialogue.yue: 我喺呢度已經見到個頂。

items.example: Which way to the gate?
items.say: Which way to the gate?
items.note: 美式多數讀 /wɪtʃ/。有人保留 /hw/。卡片教 /w/。

miniDialogue.en: Which lane should we join for this flight?
The blue lane. Which screen lists our flight?
miniDialogue.yue: 排藍色嗰條。邊個螢幕有我哋班機？

items.example: Your gate is on the left.
items.say: Your gate is on the left.
items.note: 開頭 /l/，元音 /ɛ/。同 lift 只差個元音。

miniDialogue.en: The pharmacy is on the left after the bridge.
Look for the green cross on the sign.
miniDialogue.yue: 搵個有綠色十字嘅招牌。

items.example: Take the lift on the left.
items.say: Take the lift on the left.
items.note: 對比組。/lɪft/ 係升降機。left /lɛft/ 係左邊。

miniDialogue.en: Take the lift to the fifth floor.
I see the lift. Say lift, not left.
miniDialogue.yue: 我見到部升降機。讀 lift（/ɪ/），唔好讀成 left（/ɛ/）。

items.example: This is not the right street.
items.say: This is not the right street.
items.note: 對比組。street 係長 /i/。straight 先至係 /eɪ/。

miniDialogue.en: This is not the right street for the hotel.
miniDialogue.yue: 呢條唔係去酒店嗰條街。

miniDialogue.en: Keep going. Our street is the next one, and it is not straight.
miniDialogue.yue: 繼續行。我哋條街係下一條，而且唔係 straight。

items.arpabet: S IH0 K Y UH1 R AH0 T IY0
items.example: Security is this way.
items.say: [[sɪkjˈʊɹəti]] is this way.
items.note: 四個音節。CMU 第一個音係 /sɪ/。有人讀成 /sə/。卡片跟 CMU。

miniDialogue.en: Security is down this corridor.
miniDialogue.yue: 安檢沿住呢條走廊行落去。

miniDialogue.en: Thanks. Is the queue at security moving?

items.example: Which way to the gate?
items.say: Which way to the gate?

miniDialogue.en: Which way to the gate from here?
Go past the shops and turn left. I can show you which way.
miniDialogue.yue: 過咗啲舖轉左。我可以指畀你睇邊邊行。

items.arpabet: S T R EY1 T AH0 HH EH1 D
items.example: Go straight ahead, please.
items.say: Go straight ahead, please.

miniDialogue.en: Go straight ahead until the fountain.
Continue straight ahead, then the counters are on your right.
miniDialogue.yue: 繼續直行，跟住啲櫃檯喺你右邊。

items.arpabet: TH AE1 NG K Y UW1
items.example: Thank you.
items.say: Thank you.

miniDialogue.en: Thank you. The clasp sits perfectly.
Glad it fits. Thank you for your patience earlier.
miniDialogue.yue: 好彩啱。多謝你頭先咁有耐心。

items.arpabet: AH0 V K AO1 R S
items.example: Of course.
items.say: [[əv kˈɔɹs.]]
items.note: of 喺呢度弱讀 /əv/。錄音用同一個弱讀，唔係單獨唸 of 嗰個 /ʌv/。

miniDialogue.en: Of course you can sit here.
Thanks. Of course I will move if needed.
miniDialogue.yue: 唔該。有需要我當然會讓。

items.arpabet: G UH1 D M AO1 R N IH0 NG
items.example: Good morning.
items.say: Good morning.

miniDialogue.en: Good morning. I came for the repair.
Good morning. The repair is ready for pickup.

items.arpabet: N AY1 S T AH0 M IY1 T Y UW1
items.jyutping: hou2 gou1 hing3 jing6 sik1 nei5
items.example: Nice to meet you.
items.say: Nice to meet you.
items.note: to 弱讀 /tə/。

miniDialogue.en: Nice to meet you. I just joined the team.
miniDialogue.yue: 好高興認識你。我啱啱加入團隊。

miniDialogue.en: Nice to meet you too. Welcome to the team.
miniDialogue.yue: 我都好高興認識你。歡迎加入團隊。

items.arpabet: JH AH1 S T L UH1 K IH0 NG
items.example: I'm just looking.
items.say: I'm just looking.
items.pitfallsYue: 我睇吓先。直譯成只係睇吓唔自然。

examples.en: I'm just looking.
examples.yue: 我睇吓先。
examples.say: I'm just looking.

examples.en: I'm just looking at the gold.
examples.yue: 我睇吓呢件金飾先。
examples.say: I'm just looking at the gold.

examples.en: I'm just looking, thanks.
examples.yue: 我睇吓先，唔該。

miniDialogue.en: I'm just looking.
I'm just looking at the gold.

items.arpabet: HH AW1 M EY1 AY1 HH EH1 L P Y UW1
items.jyutping: jau5 me1 ho2 ji5 bong1 dou2 nei5
collocations: how may I help you today
items.example: How may I help you?
items.say: How may I help you?

miniDialogue.en: How may I help you with the gift list?
miniDialogue.yue: 份禮物清單，有咩可以幫到你？

miniDialogue.en: I'm just browsing for a silver bracelet.
miniDialogue.yue: 我隨便睇吓，想搵隻銀手鈪。

items.arpabet: B AO1 R D IH0 NG P AE1 S
items.example: Here is your boarding pass.
items.say: Here is your boarding pass.

miniDialogue.en: I can't find my boarding pass in the bag.
miniDialogue.yue: 我喺袋入面搵唔到登機證。

miniDialogue.en: Check the side pocket. Your boarding pass is there.
miniDialogue.yue: 睇吓側袋。你張登機證喺嗰度。

items.arpabet: W IH1 N D OW0 S IY1 T
items.example: A window seat, please.
items.say: A window seat, please.

miniDialogue.en: A window seat, please, on the left.
The window seat in row twelve is open.
miniDialogue.yue: 十二行嗰個靠窗位仲有。

items.arpabet: AH0 T EY1 B AH0 L F ER0 T UW1
items.example: A table for two, please.
items.say: [[ə ˈteɪbəl fɚ ˈtu]] , please.
items.note: a 弱讀 /ə/，for 弱讀 /fɚ/。錄音用呢兩個弱讀。

miniDialogue.en: Do you have a table for two?
Yes. A table for two by the window.

items.example: We are at check-in.
items.say: We are at check-in.
items.note: check 係 /tʃɛk/，in 係 /ɪn/。成個詞冇 /ʃ/。

miniDialogue.en: We are at check-in for Taipei.
miniDialogue.yue: 我哋而家喺飛台北嘅辦理登機處。

miniDialogue.en: This check-in counter serves Taipei departures.
miniDialogue.yue: 呢個辦理登機櫃檯負責台北出發。

items.arpabet: R AY1 T DH IH1 S W EY1
items.example: Right this way.
items.say: Right this way.

miniDialogue.en: Right this way. The corner booth is yours.
miniDialogue.yue: 請跟我嚟。角落嗰個卡位係你嘅。

miniDialogue.en: Thank you. Is that booth quiet enough to talk?
miniDialogue.yue: 多謝。嗰個卡位夠唔夠靜傾偈？

items.arpabet: L EH1 T M IY1 N OW1
collocations: let me know if you need anything
items.example: Let me know if you need anything.
items.say: Let me know if you need anything.

miniDialogue.en: Let me know if the band feels tight.
miniDialogue.yue: 如果個圈太緊就話我知。

miniDialogue.en: I will. Also let me know when the polish is finished.
miniDialogue.yue: 我會。拋光好咗都話我知。

items.example: I have four.
items.say: I have four.

miniDialogue.en: I brought four cups for the meeting.
Good. Four people just sat down.

items.example: It is five dollars.
items.say: It is five dollars.
items.note: 尾音收到 /v/。唔好食咗，變成 fine。

miniDialogue.en: Please cut the cake into five equal slices.
miniDialogue.yue: 請將蛋糕切成五件一樣大。

miniDialogue.en: The children are waiting with plates.

items.example: It is six dollars.
items.say: It is six dollars.
items.note: 尾音係 /ks/。唔好變成 sick。

miniDialogue.en: Each pineapple bun is six dollars.
Then six buns cost thirty-six dollars.
miniDialogue.yue: 咁六個包就係三十六蚊。

items.example: It opens at seven.
items.say: It opens at seven.

miniDialogue.en: The alarm rings at seven on weekdays.
I set a second alarm five minutes later.
miniDialogue.yue: 我再定多一個，遲五分鐘。

items.example: It opens at eight.
items.say: It opens at eight.

miniDialogue.en: My shift starts at eight, so I must leave.
A taxi to the station would help.

items.example: We close at nine.
items.say: We close at nine.

miniDialogue.en: The kitchen takes the last order at nine.
miniDialogue.yue: 廚房九點收最後嗰張單。

miniDialogue.en: Nine is fine. We will not stay past that.
miniDialogue.yue: 九點得。我哋唔會留過嗰陣。

items.example: Ten people can sit at this table on Friday.
items.exampleYue: 星期五呢張檯可以坐十個人。
items.say: Ten people can sit at this table on Friday.
items.note: 尾音 /n/ 要留低。

miniDialogue.en: Can this round table seat ten guests?
miniDialogue.yue: 呢張圓枱坐唔坐得十個客人？

miniDialogue.en: Yes. Ten is the full setting.

items.example: It is ten dollars.
items.say: It is ten dollars.
items.note: 教 CMU 第一條 /ˈdɑl.ɚ/，同 Wiktionary 美式 /ˈdɑ.lɚ/ 同一個元音。CMU 第二條 /ˈdɔ.lɚ/ 標做變體。

miniDialogue.en: The chain is ten dollars.
Ten dollars is fair. I'll take the chain.

items.example: I don't have enough money.
items.say: I don't have enough money.

miniDialogue.en: I don't have enough money on me.
The card reader works if money is short.
miniDialogue.yue: 如果錢唔夠，部卡機用得。

items.example: How much is this?
items.say: How much is this?

miniDialogue.en: Did you lock the door how?
Yes. I checked twice.

items.example: How much is the ring?
items.say: How much is the ring?

miniDialogue.en: How much rice should I cook for four people?
Two cups of dry rice will be plenty.

items.example: Look at the clock.
items.say: Look at the clock.

miniDialogue.en: Look at the clock over the counter.
The clock says twenty past seven.

items.example: It is three o'clock.
items.say: It is three o'clock.

miniDialogue.en: Does the tour start at three o'clock?
It starts at four o'clock sharp.

items.example: The price is ten dollars.
items.say: The price is ten dollars.
items.usageNotes: The price is ten dollars. How much is the price?
items.pitfallsYue: 價錢。問法可以用 How much does it cost?

examples.en: The price is ten dollars.
examples.yue: 價錢係十蚊。
examples.say: The price is ten dollars.

examples.en: The price includes tax.
examples.yue: 價錢已經包稅。
examples.say: The price includes tax.

examples.en: Is this the final price?
examples.yue: 呢個係咪實價？

miniDialogue.en: The price is ten dollars.
The price includes tax.

items.example: Wait a minute.
items.say: [[wˈeɪt ə mˈɪnət]]
items.note: 時間嗰個讀音。CMU 另有形容詞「極細」M AY0 N UW1 T，呢張卡唔教。

miniDialogue.en: Wait a minute while I find the form.
No problem. A minute is plenty.

items.example: I waited for one hour.
items.say: I waited for one hour.
items.note: CMU 第一條 AW1 ER0，卡片 /ˈaʊ.ɚ/，同 Wiktionary 美式 /aʊɚ/。第二條 AW1 R 係 /ˈaʊɹ/，標做變體。

miniDialogue.en: I waited for one hour outside.
Please come in. An hour outside is far too long.
miniDialogue.yue: 請入嚟。喺出面等一個鐘太耐。

items.example: What time is it now?
items.say: What time is it now?

miniDialogue.en: If we leave now, we can catch the tram.
miniDialogue.yue: 我哋而家走就趕得切電車。

miniDialogue.en: I am putting my shoes on by the door.

items.example: I am fine.
items.say: I am fine.
items.note: 對比組。尾音係 /n/，唔係 five 嘅 /v/。

miniDialogue.en: Are you fine after standing all morning?
A short rest and some water will help.

items.example: I am sick.
items.say: I am sick.
items.note: 對比組。冇 six 尾嗰個 /s/。

miniDialogue.en: I am sick and cannot start my shift.
Please rest. Say sick, not six.
miniDialogue.yue: 好好休息。讀 sick，唔好讀成 six，尾音冇 /s/。

items.arpabet: IH0 K S K Y UW1 Z
items.example: Excuse me.
items.say: [[ɪkskjˈuz]] me.
items.note: Excuse me 用動詞，尾音 /z/。名詞「藉口」先至係 /s/。Wiktionary 美式動詞 /ɪksˈkjuz/，名詞 /ɪksˈkjus/。錄音強制動詞，因為 Piper 讀個串法會變成名詞。

miniDialogue.en: Please excuse my mistake on the invoice.
miniDialogue.say: Please [[ɛkskjˈuːz]] my mistake on the invoice.

miniDialogue.en: The error is small, and I can forgive it.

items.example: I'm sorry about the wait.
items.say: I'm [[ˈsɑɹi]] about the wait.
items.note: 卡片跟 CMU 同 Wiktionary 美式主條 /ˈsɑ.ɹi/。Simple English Wiktionary 亦列美式 /ˈsɔ.ɹi/，標做變體。

miniDialogue.en: I am sorry about the long wait.
That's all right. I am sorry I looked impatient.
miniDialogue.yue: 冇事。對唔住，我頭先個樣好急。

items.arpabet: P AA1 R D AH0 N
items.jyutping: m4 goi1 zoi3 gong2 jat1 ci3
items.example: Pardon me.
items.say: Pardon me.

miniDialogue.en: Pardon me, I missed the gate number.
miniDialogue.yue: 唔該再講一次，我聽漏咗閘口號碼。

miniDialogue.en: It is gate twenty. Pardon the noisy speaker.
miniDialogue.yue: 二十號閘。廣播喇叭有啲嘈，唔好意思。

items.example: Good night.
